mapper.select: SELECT dcr08_often_use_id AS often_use_id , m.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS l_class_tree_id , s.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS m_class_tree_id , dcr08_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , dcr08_class_detail_id AS class_detail_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr08_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , dcr07_class_detail_nm AS class_detail_name , dcr08_count AS count FROM dcr08_often_use INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree s ON s.dcr01_class_tree_id = dcr08_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr01_class_tree m ON m.dcr01_class_tree_id = s.dcr01_parent_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr07_class_detail ON dcr07_class_detail_id = dcr08_class_detail_id WHERE dcr08_person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY dcr08_count DESC
